question: Where should the name people see change to VerOS NT, and which ReactOS mentions have to stay?
allowedInputs: sdk/include/reactos/version.rc, which already stored the product name separately from the legal copyright line
The English product strings, boot menu, and service display names already changed to VerOS NG in this tree
The remaining dialog and registry display strings, in every locale, that still called this system ReactOS
veros/logo/VerOS NG Logo.jpg, the existing slate, blue, and teal mark
GPL-2.0 section 1, which requires existing copyright and license notices to stay
The user instruction to use the tagline True NT. Open Core. and to add a vector drawing of the logo

cursor.prompt: Rename the OS to VerOS NT. Implement the plan. Use the tagline True NT. Open Core. Generate vector graphics of the logo too.

measuredEffect.note: The before and after values are the product-name macro in that file. LegalCopyright still names the ReactOS Project. Boot paths, CMake macros, and the ReactOSSetup boot type were not renamed.
